title: A surjective flat closed immersion is an isomorphism
statement: Let $i:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $i$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], then $i$ is an isomorphism of schemes.

source.place: Tag 04PW, morphisms-lemma-characterize-flat-closed-immersions, final assertion with the underlying closed subset equal to the whole target; the flat-surjective closed-immersion corollary used in Tag 05XD.
